title: Second Opium War
summary: Britain and France fought Qing China to gain greater commercial access, beginning after the seizure of the British-registered 'Arrow' in October 1856. Anglo-French forces took Canton, the Taku Forts and Beijing. The Convention of Peking ended the war, opening China further to Western trade and ceding Kowloon to Britain.

as_recorded.value: Between 1856 and 1860, British-Indian forces joined the French
